newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican army officer punches out cop during ceremony.
newsitem.headline: Mexican army officer punches out cop during ceremony.

text.p: A Mexican army colonel punched a police officer during a ceremony on Tuesday, sending the officer to the hospital, a radio report said.
"One of the police said something about needing a payraise. The colonel spun around and punched out the first policeman he saw," a reporter for Mexico City's Radio Red said.
Policeman Julian Pacheco was sent to hospital for treatment to head injuries after being struck, according to the radio report.

A spokesman at the Ministry for Public Security told Reuters the army official struck Pacheco in self-defence following a heated exchange between the two during a ceremony intended to honour Mexico City police.

"The policeman was clearly being insubordinate. He was causing those around him to laugh out loud during a public ceremony and completely relax their discipline," Col. Hector Andres Alviso Hernandez said.
He added an investigation would be carried out to see if the army colonel, who was not identified, acted improperly.

Present at the ceremony was Gen. Enrique Salgado Cordero, who was picked by President Ernesto Zedillo to head Mexico City's police last year in an effort to improve discipline and wipe out rampant corruption.
